situation (example wording): "When was violent crime the highest?", "what year was murder the highest"
proposed behavior: "When was <crime> the highest" is the year with the highest figure in the Crime Index series, the nation by default (P180), the series starting in 1960 (P198). Asked for a count it is the count; otherwise the rate per 100,000. One sentence with the year and the figure, and the next-highest year beside it when it is within 1 percent. A place named is that place's own peak year. "Lowest" is the same with the lowest year.
exact default or choices offered: One sentence: the peak year and its rate per 100,000, with the Source line.
